newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends easier versus dollar, mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends easier versus dollar, mark.

text.p: 1545 GMT - The Swiss franc closed easier against the dollar and mark as the weak Swiss economy continued to weigh on the currency, dealers said.

"The huge jump in unemployment (in January), the bleak outlook for the economy and the weaker mark/Swiss might lead down the road to further easing steps (by the Swiss National Bank)," CSFB said in a forex strategy comment.
It said the SNB still had room for lowering rates, adding it could even cut its discount rate at some stage if Germany did.

* Dollar ends at 1.4455/4465 francs, up from yesterday's close at 1.4323/4328 and the opening at 1.4440/4450 * Mark closes at 85.88/92 Swiss centimes, up from 85.54/56 at the opening and yesterday's 85.73/76
Dealers said the mark's corrective slide against the franc after hitting a high of 87.40 appeared to be coming to an end.
"The mark will not go much below 85.50 and will move back into a range between 85.50 and 87.00," one dealer at a Swiss bank said.
CSFB also saw the mark poised to gain. "Any signs of further (SNB) policy easing could act as a trigger for a sharp upmove."
